source_video: video/Descending Col des Saisies _ French Alps #3_1080p.mp4
scope: Whole-route release roadside dressing after the accepted S01-S04 world; large spatial identities only, with no people, vehicles or HUD.

modules.ground_strategy: route tangent placement plus post-generation visible terrain/shoulder triangle audit
route tangent placement plus post-generation visible terrain/shoulder triangle audit

contact_contract.roadside_posts: upright world Y with route tangent alignment
contact_contract.wall_and_rock_foot: independent actual visible terrain/shoulder triangle audit after generation; missing samples fail ground proof
contact_contract.visible_mesh_sampler: bounded spatial index over visible SaisiesGeoTerrain and SaisiesGeoGravelShoulders triangles
contact_contract.fallback_sampler: diagnostic only; SaisiesGeoTerrain.sample_mesh_triangle cannot establish visible-mesh proof

support_point_semantics.houses_and_landmarks: first direct foundation/base MeshInstance actual indexed bottom vertices; roofs, signs and decorative descendants are excluded
support_point_semantics.power_poles: first direct mast MeshInstance actual indexed bottom vertices; crossarms and wires are excluded
support_point_semantics.speed_signs: first direct sign mast MeshInstance actual indexed bottom vertices; the sign face is excluded
support_point_semantics.direction_signs: first direct junction sign mast MeshInstance actual indexed bottom vertices; sign boards and labels are excluded
support_point_semantics.junction_branch: actual indexed pavement bottom vertices; the release branch is draped from the helper's cached visible terrain triangles after cache warm-up; painted edge bars and give-way/centre marks are excluded
support_point_semantics.wall_caps: upper wall cap segments are named uniquely for side-clearance coverage but excluded from terrain-foot support auditing
support_point_semantics.rock_cuts: actual indexed mesh footline vertices selected against the authored route-ground toe
support_point_semantics.rail_posts: transformed BoxMesh bottom-face support points, not MultiMesh origins
support_point_semantics.foundation_embedding: farm foundation burial is reported as a declared depth range and classified as expected embedding; positive float and over-embedding remain failures
support_point_semantics.pre_fix_audit: round36_release/capture.json retained as the pre_support_semantics_fix audit; its AABB-derived rock extremes are diagnostic only

geometry_repair.pass_order: warm the bounded visible-terrain triangle cache, fit release support meshes, drape the S18 branch, then rerun the actual-vertex audit
geometry_repair.solid_supports: first direct foundation/base meshes are rebuilt from actual indexed vertices with bottoms sampled from the visible terrain; farm bottoms retain their declared burial depth
geometry_repair.wall_segments: wall body endpoints are shifted outward at route bends and fitted at their actual bottom vertices; paired caps receive the same endpoint shifts and remain excluded from terrain-foot counts
geometry_repair.rock_toes: only positive vertices in the actual route-ground-selected rock toe ring are lowered to the sampled terrain; high rock faces remain authored
geometry_repair.mesh_streams: single-surface fitted meshes preserve indexed UVs and the authored surface material while retaining any node material_override; multi-surface meshes are left unrepaired rather than losing a stream
geometry_repair.solid_inversion: each fitted bottom vertex is checked against the nearest corresponding authored top XZ vertex; terrain above that top leaves the original solid and records a repair miss
geometry_repair.cache_padding: plain baked terrain contact bins use one 24m query-bin radius so sub-metre wall endpoint corrections remain queryable before exact XZ resampling
geometry_repair.failure_policy: positive floats, unexpected deep embedding and route-side clearance failures remain blocking contract results

contact_contract.rail_clearance: rails use road half width plus 0.66m side offset; S18 bridge rails are checked against the branch throat

rail_source.reuse_contract: When the accepted R14/R35 SaisiesGeoRoadside guardrail groups are present, matching upper and lower spans are reused and release duplicates are suppressed.
release_additions: S18 junction throat bridge rail, left
S18 junction throat bridge rail, right
rail_source.missing_base_behavior: If the base guardrail groups are absent, release Upper/Lower author the same matched spans and publish source metadata as release-authored.

contact_contract.forest_clearance: roadside module does not spawn trees; release forest owns tree roots and openings
contact_contract.duplicate_hides: only bounded S09 upper-wall overlap may be hidden and is recorded in runtime metadata
